setup: Three separate contacts; reposition between trials without resetting contact history.
name: Third-contact jump

oracle.name: Third-contact jump
oracle.law: Every third separate contact between the original red and blue balls sets both upward velocities to 4. Sustained contact counts once. Floor, wall, and apparatus contacts do not count. The rule follows object identity, not color. Contacts with added balls do not increment this count.
oracle.condition: The original red–blue pair makes its third distinct contact.
oracle.effect: Both receive an upward kick. The count then continues to the next third contact.
oracle.scope: Sustained contact counts once. Wall, floor and added-ball contacts do not increment this counter.

reference: Same geometry, masses and scripted actions; the altered program is disabled only in the ordinary-physics reference.
